WITH alpha_gen AS (
    SELECT investmentref
    FROM risk_metrics
    WHERE alpha5y > 0
),
return_consistency AS (
    SELECT portfolioref,
           CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN fundperf > 0 THEN 1 END) AS numeric) / 
           CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN fundperf IS NOT NULL AND fundperf != 0 THEN 1 END) AS numeric) * 100 AS consistency_pct
    FROM annual_returns
    GROUP BY portfolioref
),
consistent_outperformer AS (
    SELECT ag.investmentref
    FROM alpha_gen ag
    JOIN return_consistency rc ON ag.investmentref = rc.portfolioref
    WHERE rc.consistency_pct > 80
),

    SELECT tickersym
    FROM funds
    WHERE equityweight IS NOT NULL AND equityweight != 0
      AND yieldrate IS NOT NULL AND yieldrate != 0
)
SELECT f.tickersym,
       f.shortlabel,
       f.fulldescription,
       f.parentgroup,
       f.productclass,
       f.equityweight,
       f.yieldrate
FROM consistent_outperformer co
JOIN total_return_fund trf ON co.investmentref = trf.tickersym
JOIN funds f ON co.investmentref = f.tickersym;
